# AI-Political
> The Real Danger in AI Isn't Artificial. Book and argument by Yuval Dvir.

The book argues that the binding constraint on AI is human politics (status, tribe, ego), not model capability, and that apolitical, truth-seeking AI can flip incentives toward honesty and competence.
